// CINEMALAND — La Vidéothèque de Michel et Christiane
// Secrets requis : ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, TMDB_API_KEY

const REPOSITORY = 'michelmalandain/Videotheque';
const OWNER = 'michelmalandain';
const SITE_ORIGIN = 'https://michelmalandain.github.io';
const ALLOWED_SITE_ORIGINS = [SITE_ORIGIN, 'https://cinemaland.fr', 'https://www.cinemaland.fr'];
const isSiteOrigin = origin => ALLOWED_SITE_ORIGINS.includes(origin);

const ADMIN_HTML = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Administration — CINEMALAND</title>
<style>
:root{--gold:#e8b85b}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#53151c,#14090c 52%,#07080b);color:#f6e8cf;font:18px Georgia,serif}
.curtain{height:34px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#490810 0,#a5202d 22px,#590b15 42px);border-bottom:5px solid #c69a51}

h1{color:#f5cc7b;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,46px);margin:0}
main{max-width:1650px;margin:35px auto;padding:0 18px}
.admin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.admin-grid .box{min-width:0;margin-bottom:0}
@media(max-width:1100px){.admin-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}#moderation{grid-column:1/-1}}@media(max-width:750px){.admin-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#moderation{grid-column:auto}}
.box{border:3px double #c89442;border-radius:9px;background:#101317;padding:28px;margin-bottom:24px}
label{display:block;margin:18px 0 7px;color:#f5cc7b}

button{margin-top:25px;padding:14px 20px;background:#7e101a;border:1px solid #c89442;color:#fff1d4;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button:hover{background:#a31b28}
button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}
p{line-height:1.55}
a{color:#f5cc7b}
footer{text-align:center;padding:30px}
#message{border-left:4px solid var(--gold);padding:15px;background:#171b20}
#message:empty{display:none}
#message[data-state='pending']{border-left-color:#e8b85b;background:#40300c}
#message[data-state='success']{border-left-color:#63d58c;background:#123e26;color:#c8ffdb;font-weight:bold}
#message[data-state='error']{border-left-color:#ef6c76;background:#4b1720;color:#ffe2e5}
.box:has(#add){background:#173f28;border-color:#58b878}
.box:has(#remove){background:#541c23;border-color:#d35b62}
#add button{background:#218447}
#remove button{background:#ae2634}
/* Bandeau identique aux pages Films et Séries */
header{height:auto;aspect-ratio:1765/290;padding:0!important;background:#20070c!important;border-bottom:3px solid #e6b968!important;box-shadow:0 9px 25px #000a}
header h1,header p{display:none}
header .admin-bandeau-image{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill}
nav.cinemaland-nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;background:#180609ed;border-bottom:2px solid #c89442;box-shadow:0 3px 15px #000b}
nav.cinemaland-nav a{display:inline-block;padding:11px 20px;border:1px solid #a77730;background:#7e101a;color:#f4dcae;text-decoration:none;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.04em}
nav.cinemaland-nav a:hover{background:#a51c29}
nav.cinemaland-nav .proposer{border:2px solid #ffe3a1;box-shadow:0 0 9px #ffc46e,0 0 22px #b52843;text-shadow:0 0 9px #ffcf75}
#moderation{margin-top:0!important;background:#292033;border-color:#b49ad2}
@media(max-width:650px){header{aspect-ratio:1765/350}}

/* Recherche TMDB administrateur — ajout sans modifier le bandeau */
#tmdb-admin-search{margin:0 0 24px;background:#211922;border-color:#d9ac60}
#tmdb-admin-search .search-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:end}
#tmdb-admin-search button{margin-top:0}
#tmdb-results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
.tmdb-card{display:flex;gap:12px;background:#111820;border:1px solid #987642;border-radius:7px;padding:12px}
.tmdb-card img{width:75px;height:110px;object-fit:cover;background:#343039;flex-shrink:0}
.tmdb-card strong{display:block;color:#f5cc7b}.tmdb-card small{display:block;color:#ddd;margin:5px 0}
.tmdb-card button{padding:8px 10px;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px}
#tmdb-person{margin-top:16px;white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:800px){#tmdb-admin-search .search-line{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="curtain"></div>
<header>
<img class="admin-bandeau-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Le cinéma des Malandain">
<h1>🔐 Administration</h1>
<p>La Vidéothèque de Michel et Christiane</p>
</header>
<nav class="cinemaland-nav" aria-label="Navigation CINEMALAND">
<a href="https://michelmalandain.github.io/Videotheque/index.html">ACCUEIL</a>
<a href="https://michelmalandain.github.io/Videotheque/films.html">FILMS</a>
<a href="https://michelmalandain.github.io/Videotheque/series.html">SÉRIES</a>
<a class="proposer" href="https://michelmalandain.github.io/Videotheque/films.html">PROPOSER UN FILM</a>
<a href="https://cinemaland.fr/a-voir.html">À VOIR</a>
<a href="https://cinemaland.fr/admin2-films.html" style="background:#e8b85b;color:#241506;border:2px solid #ffe3a1;font-weight:bold">MODIFICATION FILMS ET SÉRIES</a>
<a href="https://cinemaland.fr/admin2-acteurs.html" style="background:#e8b85b;color:#241506;border:2px solid #ffe3a1;font-weight:bold">MODIFICATION ACTEURS ET RÉALISATEURS</a>
</nav>
<main>
<div class="box">
<label for="password">Votre mot de passe</label>
<input id="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required>
<p>Renseignez votre mot de passe, puis ajoutez ou supprimez un titre.</p>
</div>

<p id="message" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>


<section class="box" id="tmdb-admin-search">
<h2>RECHERCHE TMDB — ADMINISTRATION</h2>
<p>Retrouvez un film ou une série sans connaître son année, ou recherchez un acteur ou un réalisateur. Le mot de passe administrateur est obligatoire.</p>
<div class="search-line">
<div><label for="tmdb-type">Rechercher</label><select id="tmdb-type"><option value="movie">Film</option><option value="tv">Série</option><option value="actor">Acteur / Actrice</option><option value="director">Réalisateur / Réalisatrice</option></select></div>
<div><label for="tmdb-query">Titre ou nom</label><input id="tmdb-query" placeholder="Ex. La Cité de la peur" maxlength="120"></div>
<button type="button" id="tmdb-search-button">RECHERCHER</button>
</div>
<p id="tmdb-info" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<div id="tmdb-results"></div><div id="tmdb-person"></div>
</section>


<section class="box" id="production-review" style="margin:24px 0;background:#17251f;border-color:#72ae81">
<h2>PAYS DE PRODUCTION À VÉRIFIER</h2>
<p>Films et séries sans pays renseigné. TMDB propose les pays ; vous confirmez avant enregistrement dans le catalogue.</p>
<button type="button" id="production-load">AFFICHER LES TITRES À VÉRIFIER</button>
<p id="production-message" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<div id="production-list"></div>
</section>

<div class="admin-grid">
<div class="box">
<h2>➕ Ajouter un film ou une série</h2>
<form id="add">
<label for="title">Titre exact</label>
<input id="title" maxlength="160" required placeholder="Ex. Gladiator">
<label for="kind">Catégorie</label>
<select id="kind">
<option>Film</option>
<option>Série</option>
</select>
<label for="year">Année de sortie</label>
<input id="year" type="number" min="1888" max="2100" required placeholder="Ex. 2000">
<button type="submit">Ajouter à la vidéothèque</button>
</form>
<p>L’affiche, les genres et le résumé seront recherchés automatiquement.</p>
</div>

<div class="box">
<h2>🗑️ Supprimer un film ou une série</h2>
<form id="remove">
<label for="remove-title">Titre exact à supprimer</label>
<input id="remove-title" maxlength="160" required>
<label for="remove-kind">Catégorie</label>
<select id="remove-kind">
<option>Film</option>
<option>Série</option>
</select>
<label for="remove-year">Année enregistrée au catalogue</label>
<input id="remove-year" type="number" min="1888" max="2100" required>
<button type="submit">Supprimer de la vidéothèque</button>
</form>
</div>

<section class="box" id="moderation" style="margin-top:26px">
<h2>💬 Contributions des visiteurs à valider</h2>
<p>Commentaires et propositions restent invisibles tant que vous ne les acceptez pas.</p>
<button type="button" id="load-contributions">Afficher les contributions en attente</button>
<div id="contributions-list" aria-live="polite"></div>
</section>
</div>




</main>

<script>

// Recherche TMDB sécurisée, sans ouverture de liens externes.
(function(){
 const type=document.getElementById('tmdb-type'),query=document.getElementById('tmdb-query');
 const results=document.getElementById('tmdb-results'),info=document.getElementById('tmdb-info'),person=document.getElementById('tmdb-person');
 const password=document.getElementById('password');
 const picture=path=>path?'https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w185'+path:'';
 const addText=(el,tag,value)=>{const n=document.createElement(tag);n.textContent=value;el.appendChild(n);return n};
 async function api(params){
  const r=await fetch('/admin-tmdb?'+new URLSearchParams(params),{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+password.value},cache:'no-store'});
  const d=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(d.message||'Recherche impossible');return d;
 }
 document.getElementById('tmdb-search-button').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  results.replaceChildren();person.textContent='';info.textContent='';
  if(!password.value){info.textContent='Saisissez d’abord votre mot de passe administrateur.';password.focus();return}
  if(query.value.trim().length<2){info.textContent='Saisissez au moins deux caractères.';return}
  info.textContent='Recherche TMDB en cours…';
  try{
   const data=await api({type:type.value,q:query.value.trim()});
   const entries=data.results||[];info.textContent=entries.length?entries.length+' résultat(s) — sélectionnez la bonne fiche.':'Aucun résultat.';
   entries.forEach(item=>{
    const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='tmdb-card';
    const img=document.createElement('img');img.alt='';if(item.image)img.src=picture(item.image);card.appendChild(img);
    const content=document.createElement('div');card.appendChild(content);
    addText(content,'strong',item.title);
    addText(content,'small',[item.year,item.department,'TMDB '+item.id].filter(Boolean).join(' · '));
    const btn=addText(content,'button',data.type==='movie'||data.type==='tv'?'CHOISIR CE TITRE':'VOIR LA FICHE');btn.type='button';
    btn.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
     if(data.type==='movie'||data.type==='tv'){
      if(!item.year){info.textContent='Année indisponible pour ce titre : choisissez une autre fiche.';return}
      document.getElementById('title').value=item.title;
      document.getElementById('year').value=item.year;
      document.getElementById('kind').value=data.type==='movie'?'Film':'Série';
      info.textContent='Fiche sélectionnée : '+item.title+' ('+item.year+'). Vérifiez puis validez dans le pavé vert.';
      document.getElementById('add').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
     }else{
      // Ouvrir la fiche CINEMALAND existante, sans créer une fiche dans l'administration.
      const target=new URL(SITE_ORIGIN+'/Videotheque/index.html');
      target.searchParams.set('personne',item.title);
      target.searchParams.set('hall','1');
      target.searchParams.set('person_id',String(item.id));
      window.location.href=target.toString();

     }
    });
    results.appendChild(card);
   });
  }catch(e){info.textContent=e.message}
 });
 query.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();document.getElementById('tmdb-search-button').click()}});
})();

const message = document.getElementById('message');
let sending = false;
function setMessage(value,state){message.textContent=value;message.dataset.state=state;}

// Préremplissage depuis le bouton « Ajouter à ma vidéothèque » des fiches TMDB.
// Aucune soumission automatique : Michel garde la validation finale.
(function prefillFromFilmography(){
  const params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const title=(params.get('title')||'').trim();
  const year=params.get('year')||'';
  const kind=params.get('kind')||'';
  if(!title||title.length>160||!/^\\d{4}$/.test(year)||!['Film','Série'].includes(kind))return;
  document.getElementById('title').value=title;
  document.getElementById('year').value=year;
  document.getElementById('kind').value=kind;
  setMessage('🟢 Informations récupérées : '+title+' ('+year+'). Vérifiez puis confirmez l’ajout.','success');
})();


async function submit(e, action, prefix) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (sending) return;

  const password = document.getElementById('password');
  if (!password.value) {
    password.focus();
    return;
  }

  const title = document.getElementById(prefix + 'title').value.trim();
  const kind = document.getElementById(prefix + 'kind').value;
  const year = Number(document.getElementById(prefix + 'year').value);

  if (!title) return;

  if (action === 'delete' &&
      !confirm('Supprimer « ' + title + ' » (' + year + ') de la vidéothèque ?')) {
    return;
  }

  sending = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
  setMessage('🟡 Envoi de votre demande…','pending');
  message.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});

  try {
    const response = await fetch('/requests', {
      method:'POST',
      headers:{
        'Content-Type':'application/json',
        'Authorization':'Bearer ' + password.value
      },
      body:JSON.stringify({action, title, kind, year})
    });

    const result = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(result.message || 'Le service est momentanément indisponible.');
    }

    setMessage('🟡 GitHub travaille… Patientez, nous vérifions la publication.','pending');
    const issueNumber = result.issue_number;
    if (!Number.isInteger(issueNumber)) throw new Error('Numéro de suivi manquant. Vérifiez GitHub.');
    const started = Date.now();
    let finished = false;
    while (Date.now() - started < 240000) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
      const check = await fetch('/status?issue=' + issueNumber, {
        headers: {'Authorization':'Bearer ' + password.value}, cache:'no-store'
      });
      if (!check.ok) continue;
      const status = await check.json();
      if (status.state === 'success') {
        setMessage('🟢 ENREGISTRÉ ! « ' + title + ' » : catalogue publié et à jour.','success');
        finished = true;
        break;
      }
      if (status.state === 'error') throw new Error(status.message || 'Échec de GitHub.');
      setMessage(status.state === 'publishing'
        ? '🟡 GitHub a terminé. Publication du site en cours…'
        : '🟡 GitHub travaille… Mise à jour en cours.','pending');
    }
    if (!finished) setMessage('🟡 Vérification toujours en cours. Consultez GitHub avant de renouveler la demande.','pending');

    e.target.reset();

  } catch (error) {
    message.textContent = error instanceof TypeError
      ? 'La connexion a été interrompue. Vérifiez le catalogue dans quelques minutes avant de renouveler la demande.'
      : error.message;

  } finally {
    sending = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
  }
}

document.getElementById('add').addEventListener(
  'submit', e => submit(e, 'add', '')
);

document.getElementById('remove').addEventListener(
  'submit', e => submit(e, 'delete', 'remove-')
);


</script>

<script>
(function(){
 const btn=document.getElementById('load-contributions'),box=document.getElementById('contributions-list');
 const password=()=>document.getElementById('password').value;
 async function api(method,body){const r=await fetch('/contributions/moderation',{method,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+password(),...(body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{})},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined,cache:'no-store'});const j=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(j.message||'Erreur');return j;}
 async function load(){if(!password()){box.textContent='Saisissez votre mot de passe ci-dessus.';return;}box.textContent='Chargement…';try{const d=await api('GET');box.replaceChildren();if(!d.pending.length){box.textContent='Aucune contribution en attente.';return;}
 for(const x of d.pending){const card=document.createElement('article');card.style.cssText='padding:15px;margin:12px 0;border:1px solid #c89442;border-radius:6px;background:#20151b';const title=document.createElement('h3');title.textContent=(x.type==='comment'?'Commentaire':'Proposition de titre')+' — '+x.title+' ('+x.year+')';const detail=document.createElement('p');detail.textContent=x.kind+' · '+x.pseudo+(x.stars?' · '+ '★'.repeat(x.stars):'');const message=document.createElement('p');message.textContent=x.comment;card.append(title,detail,message);for(const [action,label] of [['approve','Accepter'],['reject','Refuser']]){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=label;b.style.marginRight='12px';b.onclick=async()=>{if(!confirm(label+' cette contribution ?'))return;b.disabled=true;try{const result=await api('POST',{id:x.id,action});if(result.suggestion){document.getElementById('title').value=result.suggestion.title;document.getElementById('kind').value=result.suggestion.kind;document.getElementById('year').value=result.suggestion.year;alert('Proposition acceptée : le formulaire vert est prérempli. Confirmez vous-même son ajout.');}await load();}catch(e){alert(e.message);b.disabled=false;}};card.append(b);}box.append(card);}
 }catch(e){box.textContent=e.message;}}
 btn.addEventListener('click',load);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
 const loadButton=document.getElementById('production-load');
 const list=document.getElementById('production-list');
 const info=document.getElementById('production-message');
 const pass=()=>document.getElementById('password').value;
 const headers=()=>({'Authorization':'Bearer '+pass()});
 async function call(path,opts={}){
  const response=await fetch(path,{...opts,headers:{...headers(),...(opts.body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{})},cache:'no-store'});
  const data=await response.json();if(!response.ok)throw Error(data.message||'Erreur de connexion');return data;
 }
 const elt=(tag,text,parent)=>{const e=document.createElement(tag);if(text!==undefined)e.textContent=text;parent.appendChild(e);return e};
 async function load(){
  if(!pass()){info.textContent='Saisissez votre mot de passe administrateur.';return}
  info.textContent='Lecture du catalogue…';list.replaceChildren();
  try{
   const data=await call('/production-review');
   info.textContent=data.items.length+' titre(s) à vérifier sur '+data.total+' titres.';
   for(const item of data.items){
    const row=elt('div',undefined,list);row.style.cssText='border:1px solid #8d9c7b;padding:14px;margin:12px 0;background:#101b17;border-radius:6px';
    if(item.poster){const pic=elt('img',undefined,row);pic.src='https://cinemaland.fr/'+(item.poster.startsWith('/')?item.poster.slice(1):item.poster);pic.alt='Affiche de '+item.title;pic.style.cssText='float:left;width:65px;max-height:95px;object-fit:contain;margin:0 12px 8px 0'}
    elt('strong',item.title+' ('+item.year+') — '+item.kind,row);
    const note=elt('p','Pays non renseigné.',row);note.style.margin='7px 0';
    const suggest=elt('button','PROPOSER AVEC TMDB',row);suggest.type='button';suggest.style.margin='6px 8px 6px 0';
    const label=elt('label','Pays de production — code ISO | nom du pays (sélection multiple possible)',row);label.style.margin='8px 0';
    const select=elt('select',undefined,row);select.multiple=true;select.size=6;select.setAttribute('aria-label','Pays de production : code ISO et nom du pays');select.style.cssText='display:block;width:100%;max-width:430px;min-height:150px;padding:8px';
    const countryCodes='AD AE AF AG AI AL AM AO AQ AR AS AT AU AW AX AZ BA BB BD BE BF BG BH BI BJ BL BM BN BO BQ BR BS BT BV BW BY BZ CA CC CD CF CG CH CI CK CL CM CN CO CR CU CV CW CX CY CZ DE DJ DK DM DO DZ EC EE EG EH ER ES ET FI FJ FK FM FO FR GA GB GD GE GF GG GH GI GL GM GN GP GQ GR GS GT GU GW GY HK HM HN HR HT HU ID IE IL IM IN IO IQ IR IS IT JE JM JO JP KE KG KH KI KM KN KP KR KW KY KZ LA LB LC LI LK LR LS LT LU LV LY MA MC MD ME MF MG MH MK ML MM MN MO MP MQ MR MS MT MU MV MW MX MY MZ NA NC NE NF NG NI NL NO NP NR NU NZ OM PA PE PF PG PH PK PL PM PN PR PS PT PW PY QA RE RO RS RU RW SA SB SC SD SE SG SH SI SJ SK SL SM SN SO SR SS ST SV SX SY SZ TC TD TF TG TH TJ TK TL TM TN TO TR TT TV TW TZ UA UG UM US UY UZ VA VC VE VG VI VN VU WF WS YE YT ZA ZM ZW'.split(' ');
    const countryNames=new Intl.DisplayNames(['fr'],{type:'region'});
    for(const code of countryCodes){const option=elt('option',code+' — '+countryNames.of(code),select);option.value=code}
    const help=elt('small','Pour plusieurs pays : maintenez Ctrl (Windows) ou Cmd (Mac) pendant la sélection.',row);help.style.display='block';help.style.marginTop='6px';
    const save=elt('button','VALIDER ET ENREGISTRER',row);save.type='button';save.style.margin='8px 0';
    const setCountries=codes=>{const wanted=new Set(codes);for(const option of select.options)option.selected=wanted.has(option.value)};
    suggest.onclick=async()=>{suggest.disabled=true;note.textContent='Recherche TMDB…';try{
      const r=await call('/production-review/suggest?index='+item.index);
      if(r.countries.length){setCountries(r.countries);note.textContent='Proposition TMDB : '+r.countries.join(', ')+' — '+r.match+' ('+r.year+'). Vérifiez la sélection avant validation.'}
      else note.textContent='Aucun pays proposé : choisissez le ou les pays dans la liste.';
     }catch(e){note.textContent=e.message}finally{suggest.disabled=false}};
    save.onclick=async()=>{
      const countries=[...select.selectedOptions].map(option=>option.value);
      if(!countries.length){note.textContent='Sélectionnez au moins un pays dans la liste.';return}
      if(!confirm('Enregistrer '+countries.map(code=>code+' — '+countryNames.of(code)).join(', ')+' pour « '+item.title+' » ?'))return;
      save.disabled=true;note.textContent='Enregistrement sur GitHub…';
      try{await call('/production-review',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({index:item.index,title:item.title,kind:item.kind,year:item.year,countries})});row.remove();info.textContent='Enregistré. Rechargez la liste pour vérifier les titres restants.'}
      catch(e){note.textContent=e.message;save.disabled=false}
    };
   }
  }catch(e){info.textContent=e.message}
 }
 loadButton.addEventListener('click',load);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>`;

const security = {
  'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
  'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
  'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer',
  'Content-Security-Policy':
    "default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: https:; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://michelmalandain.github.io; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
};

function reply(message, status = 200, extra = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({message,...extra}), {
    status,
    headers:{
      ...security,
      'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    }
  });
}

async function equalSecret(a, b) {
  const encode = value => new TextEncoder().encode(value);

  const [x, y] = await Promise.all(
    [a, b].map(value =>
      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encode(value))
    )
  );

  const left = new Uint8Array(x);
  const right = new Uint8Array(y);

  let difference = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < left.length; i++) {
    difference |= left[i] ^ right[i];
  }

  return difference === 0;
}

async function tmdb(env, path, params={}) {
 const u=new URL('https://api.themoviedb.org/3'+path);
 u.searchParams.set('api_key',env.TMDB_API_KEY);
 u.searchParams.set('language','fr-FR');
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(params))u.searchParams.set(k,v);
 const r=await fetch(u,{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});
 if(!r.ok)throw Error('TMDB indisponible ('+r.status+')');
 return r.json();
}
const normPerson=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');

async function filmography(request,env,url){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 const allowedOrigins=ALLOWED_SITE_ORIGINS;
 const headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':allowedOrigins.includes(origin)?origin:SITE_ORIGIN,'Vary':'Origin','Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff'};
 const send=(data,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers});
 if(request.method!=='GET')return send({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
 if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return send({message:'Clé TMDB absente du Worker'},503);
 try{
  const q=url.searchParams,role=q.get('role')||'all';
  if(!['actor','director','creator','all'].includes(role))return send({message:'Rôle invalide'},400);
  let id=q.get('id');
  if(id!==null&&!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id))return send({message:'Identifiant TMDB invalide'},400);
  if(!id&&q.get('imdb')){
   const imdb=q.get('imdb');
   if(!/^nm\d+$/.test(imdb))return send({message:'Identifiant IMDb invalide'},400);
   const found=await tmdb(env,'/find/'+imdb,{external_source:'imdb_id'});
   if(found.person_results?.length===1)id=found.person_results[0].id;
  }
  const name=q.get('name')||'',title=q.get('title')||'',year=q.get('year')||'',type=q.get('type')||'';
  if(!id){
   if(!name||name.length>120)return send({message:'Nom de la personne manquant'},400);
   // Identifier d'abord la personne dans les crédits du film/de la série affiché(e).
   if(title&&year&&['movie','tv'].includes(type)&&/^\d{4}$/.test(year)&&title.length<=160){
    const search=await tmdb(env,'/search/'+type,{query:title,[type==='tv'?'first_air_date_year':'year']:year});
    const candidates=(search.results||[]).filter(x=>[x.title,x.name,x.original_title,x.original_name].some(t=>t&&normPerson(t)===normPerson(title)));
    const matching=candidates.filter(x=>(x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4)===year);
    const matches=[];
    for(const candidate of (matching.length?matching:candidates).slice(0,6)){
     const detail=await tmdb(env,'/'+type+'/'+candidate.id,{append_to_response:'credits,aggregate_credits'});
     let people=[];
     if(role==='actor')people=[...(detail.credits?.cast||[]),...(detail.aggregate_credits?.cast||[])];
     else if(role==='creator')people=[...(detail.created_by||[]),...(detail.credits?.crew||[]).filter(x=>x.job==='Director'),...(detail.aggregate_credits?.crew||[]).filter(x=>(x.jobs||[]).some(j=>j.job==='Director'||j.job==='Creator'))];
     else people=[...(detail.credits?.crew||[]).filter(x=>x.job==='Director'),...(detail.aggregate_credits?.crew||[]).filter(x=>(x.jobs||[]).some(j=>j.job==='Director'))];
     for(const p of people)if(normPerson(p.name)===normPerson(name)&&p.id)matches.push(p.id);
    }
    const distinct=[...new Set(matches)];
    if(distinct.length===1)id=distinct[0];
   }
   // Repli : recherche de personne TMDB par nom exact, sans choisir un homonyme au hasard.
   if(!id){
    const search=await tmdb(env,'/search/person',{query:name});
    const exact=(search.results||[]).filter(p=>normPerson(p.name)===normPerson(name));
    if(exact.length===1)id=exact[0].id;
    else return send({message:exact.length>1?'Plusieurs personnes portent ce nom sur TMDB. Identifiant nécessaire.':'Personne introuvable sur TMDB.'},422);
   }
  }
  // Vérification obligatoire : l'identifiant résolu doit appartenir au nom demandé.
  const identity=await tmdb(env,'/person/'+id);
  if(name && normPerson(identity.name)!==normPerson(name))return send({message:'Identité TMDB différente : '+identity.name+'. Filmographie non affichée.'},409);
  // Compléter les crédits combinés avec les crédits TV explicites : certaines séries
  // ne remontent pas de manière fiable dans la liste combinée.
  const [data,tvCredits]=await Promise.all([
   tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/combined_credits'),
   tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/tv_credits')
  ]);
  const tvCast=(tvCredits.cast||[]).map(x=>({...x,media_type:'tv'}));
  const tvCrew=(tvCredits.crew||[]).map(x=>({...x,media_type:'tv'}));
  const allCast=[...(data.cast||[]),...tvCast];
  const directing=[...(data.crew||[]),...tvCrew].filter(x=>role==='creator'?['Creator','Director'].includes(x.job):x.job==='Director');
  const source=role==='actor'?allCast:role==='all'?[...allCast,...directing]:directing;
   // Exclure les apparitions en tant que soi-même et les participations non fictionnelles.
   const selfAppearance=x=>/^(self|himself|herself|themselves|lui.même|elle.même|soi.même|as self)$/i.test(String(x.character||'').trim()) || /^(self|himself|herself)$/i.test(String(x.job||'').trim());
   const candidates=new Map();
   for(const x of source){
    if(!['movie','tv'].includes(x.media_type)||!x.id||!(x.title||x.name)||selfAppearance(x))continue;
    const key=x.media_type+'-'+x.id;
    if(!candidates.has(key))candidates.set(key,x);
   }
   // TMDB ne fournit pas les genres dans combined_credits : consulter les fiches.
   // Le cache Cloudflare limite les appels répétés, sans mélanger les identités.
   const works=[...candidates.values()];
   const filtered=[];
   const excludedGenres=new Set([99,10763,10764,10767]); // Documentaire, News, Reality, Talk
   const nonFiction=/\b(documentaire|documentary|interview|entretien|making.of|behind the scenes|talk.show|reality.show|téléréalité)\b/i;
   for(let offset=0;offset<works.length;offset+=8){
    const batch=works.slice(offset,offset+8);
    const checked=await Promise.all(batch.map(async x=>{
     try{
      const detail=await tmdb(env,'/'+x.media_type+'/'+x.id);
      const genres=(detail.genres||[]).map(g=>Number(g.id));
      if(genres.some(id=>excludedGenres.has(id)))return null;
      // Les genres TMDB doivent être connus pour classer l'œuvre en fiction.
      if(!genres.length)return null;
      if(nonFiction.test(String(detail.title||detail.name||x.title||x.name)))return null;
      return {id:x.id,title:x.title||x.name,date:x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'',poster_path:x.poster_path||null,media_type:x.media_type,job:x.job||'',overview:x.overview||'',character:x.character||''};
     }catch{return null;}
    }));
    filtered.push(...checked.filter(Boolean));
   }
   return send({person_id:Number(id),person_name:identity.name,credits:filtered.sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date))});
 }catch(e){return send({message:'Connexion TMDB indisponible. Veuillez réessayer.'},502);}
}

// Avis communs : stockés dans avis.json à la racine du dépôt GitHub.
const REVIEWS_API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/contents/avis.json';
function reviewHeaders(env) {return {'Authorization':'Bearer '+env.GITHUB_TOKEN,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','Content-Type':'application/json','User-Agent':'Cinemaland-Reviews','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};}
function reviewResponse(data,status=200,origin='') {
 const headers={'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Vary':'Origin'};
 if(isSiteOrigin(origin))headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']=origin;
 return new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers});
}
function decodeReviewContent(value){const raw=atob((value||'').replace(/\s/g,''));return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(raw,c=>c.charCodeAt(0))));}
function encodeReviewContent(value){const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value,null,2)+'\n');let s='';for(const b of bytes)s+=String.fromCharCode(b);return btoa(s);}
async function reviewsRoute(request,env,url){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:{'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(origin)?origin:'null','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Content-Type, Authorization','Access-Control-Max-Age':'600','Vary':'Origin'}});
 if(!env.GITHUB_TOKEN)return reviewResponse({message:'Clé GitHub absente'},503,origin);
 if(!['GET','POST'].includes(request.method))return reviewResponse({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405,origin);
 if(request.method==='POST'){
   if(!isSiteOrigin(origin) && origin!==url.origin)return reviewResponse({message:'Origine non autorisée'},403,origin);
   const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
   if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reviewResponse({message:'Mot de passe incorrect'},401,origin);
   let data;try {if(Number(request.headers.get('Content-Length')||0)>5000)throw Error();data=await request.json();}catch{return reviewResponse({message:'Données invalides'},400,origin);}
   const {title,kind,year,stars,comment,watch}=data||{};
   if(typeof title!=='string'||!title.trim()||title.length>160||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(title)||!['Film','Série'].includes(kind)||!Number.isInteger(year)||year<1888||year>2100||!Number.isInteger(stars)||stars<0||stars>5||typeof comment!=='string'||comment.length>1500||typeof watch!=='boolean')return reviewResponse({message:'Vérifiez les champs (0 à 5 étoiles, 1500 caractères maximum).'},400,origin);
   const id=kind+'|'+year+'|'+title.trim().normalize('NFC').toLocaleLowerCase('fr');
   for(let attempt=0;attempt<3;attempt++){
    let sha,all={};
    try{
     const get=await fetch(REVIEWS_API+'?t='+Date.now(),{headers:reviewHeaders(env),cf:{cacheTtl:0}});
     if(get.status!==404){if(!get.ok)return reviewResponse({message:'Lecture GitHub impossible ('+get.status+').'},502,origin);const doc=await get.json();sha=doc.sha;all=decodeReviewContent(doc.content);}
     if(!all||typeof all!=='object'||Array.isArray(all))all={};
     all[id]={title:title.trim(),kind,year,stars,comment:comment.trim(),watch,updated:new Date().toISOString()};
     const body={message:'CINEMALAND : avis '+title.trim(),content:encodeReviewContent(all)};
     if(sha)body.sha=sha;
     const put=await fetch(REVIEWS_API,{method:'PUT',headers:reviewHeaders(env),body:JSON.stringify(body)});
     if(put.status===409||put.status===422)continue;
     if(!put.ok)return reviewResponse({message:'Écriture GitHub refusée ('+put.status+'). Vérifiez le droit Contents: write du jeton.'},502,origin);
     return reviewResponse({message:'Avis enregistré sur GitHub.',review:all[id]},200,origin);
    }catch{return reviewResponse({message:'Connexion GitHub indisponible.'},502,origin);}
   }
   return reviewResponse({message:'Modification simultanée, veuillez réessayer.'},409,origin);
 }
 try{
  const r=await fetch(REVIEWS_API+'?t='+Date.now(),{headers:reviewHeaders(env),cf:{cacheTtl:0}});
  if(r.status===404)return reviewResponse({reviews:{}},200,origin);
  if(!r.ok)return reviewResponse({message:'Avis indisponibles'},502,origin);
  const doc=await r.json();return reviewResponse({reviews:decodeReviewContent(doc.content)},200,origin);
 }catch{return reviewResponse({message:'Avis indisponibles'},502,origin);}
}

// CINEMALAND : bande-annonce TMDB, version française prioritaire.
async function trailerRoute(request,env,url){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 const headers={'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'public, max-age=3600','Vary':'Origin','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff'};
 if(isSiteOrigin(origin))headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']=origin;
 const send=(data,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers});
 if(request.method!=='GET')return send({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
 if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return send({message:'TMDB non configuré'},503);
 const q=url.searchParams,type=q.get('type'),title=(q.get('title')||'').trim(),year=q.get('year')||'';
 if(!['movie','tv'].includes(type)||title.length<1||title.length>160||!/^\d{4}$/.test(year))return send({message:'Paramètres invalides'},400);
 try{
  const search=await tmdb(env,'/search/'+type,{query:title,[type==='tv'?'first_air_date_year':'year']:year});
  const normalize=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
  const candidates=(search.results||[]).filter(x=>[x.title,x.name,x.original_title,x.original_name].some(t=>normalize(t)===normalize(title)));
  const exact=candidates.find(x=>(x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4)===year);
  if(!exact)return send({key:null});
  const [fr,en]=await Promise.all([
   tmdb(env,'/'+type+'/'+exact.id+'/videos',{language:'fr-FR'}),
   tmdb(env,'/'+type+'/'+exact.id+'/videos',{language:'en-US'})
  ]);
  const trailers=[...(fr.results||[]),...(en.results||[])].filter(x=>x.site==='YouTube'&&x.type==='Trailer'&&/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(x.key));
  const preferred=trailers.find(x=>x.iso_639_1==='fr'&&x.official)||trailers.find(x=>x.iso_639_1==='fr')||trailers.find(x=>x.official)||trailers[0];
  return send({key:preferred?.key||null});
 }catch{return send({message:'Bandes-annonces temporairement indisponibles'},502);}
}


// Contributions publiques CINEMALAND : fichiers distincts des avis privés.
// KV privé : binding Cloudflare CONTRIBUTIONS_KV requis.
const CONTRIBUTIONS_PENDING='contributions-en-attente.json';
const CONTRIBUTIONS_PUBLIC='commentaires-publics.json';
function contributionsCors(request,url){const o=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';return isSiteOrigin(o)||o===url.origin?o:'';}
function contributionsReply(data,status=200,origin=''){return reviewResponse(data,status,origin);}
async function contributionsRead(env,name){
 const r=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+name+'?t='+Date.now(),{headers:reviewHeaders(env),cache:'no-store'});
 if(r.status===404)return {sha:null,items:[]};
 if(!r.ok)throw Error('Lecture GitHub '+r.status);
 const j=await r.json(),items=decodeReviewContent(j.content);
 return {sha:j.sha,items:Array.isArray(items)?items:[]};
}
async function contributionsWrite(env,name,items,sha){
 const body={message:'CINEMALAND : mise à jour contributions',content:encodeReviewContent(items)};
 if(sha)body.sha=sha;
 const r=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+name,{method:'PUT',headers:reviewHeaders(env),body:JSON.stringify(body)});
 if(!r.ok)throw Error('Écriture GitHub '+r.status);
}
async function contributionsRoute(request,env,url){
 const origin=contributionsCors(request,url);
 if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:{'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':origin||'null','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Content-Type, Authorization','Access-Control-Max-Age':'600','Vary':'Origin'}});
 if(!env.GITHUB_TOKEN)return contributionsReply({message:'Service non configuré.'},503,origin);
 const path=url.pathname;
 if(path==='/contributions/config'&&request.method==='GET')return contributionsReply({sitekey:env.TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY||null,enabled:!!(env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV&&env.TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY&&env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY)},200,origin);
 if(path==='/contributions/public'&&request.method==='GET'){
  try{const {items}=await contributionsRead(env,CONTRIBUTIONS_PUBLIC);const kind=url.searchParams.get('kind'),year=Number(url.searchParams.get('year')),title=(url.searchParams.get('title')||'').trim().normalize('NFC').toLocaleLowerCase('fr');
  return contributionsReply({comments:items.filter(x=>x.type==='comment'&&x.kind===kind&&x.year===year&&x.title.normalize('NFC').toLocaleLowerCase('fr')===title).map(({pseudo,comment,stars,created})=>({pseudo,comment,stars,created}))},200,origin);
  }catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Commentaires indisponibles'},502,origin);}
 }
 if(path==='/contributions/submit'&&request.method==='POST'){
  if(!isSiteOrigin(origin))return contributionsReply({message:'Origine non autorisée'},403,origin);
  if(!env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV||!env.TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY||!env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY)return contributionsReply({message:'Protection antispam non configurée.'},503,origin);
  let data;try{if(Number(request.headers.get('Content-Length')||0)>6000)throw Error();data=await request.json();}catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Demande invalide'},400,origin);}
  const {type,kind,title,year,pseudo,comment,stars,token,website}=data||{};
  if(website)return contributionsReply({message:'Merci, demande reçue.'},200,origin);
  if(!['comment','suggestion'].includes(type)||!['Film','Série'].includes(kind)||typeof title!=='string'||!title.trim()||title.length>160||typeof pseudo!=='string'||pseudo.trim().length<2||pseudo.length>50||typeof comment!=='string'||comment.trim().length<3||comment.length>1500||!Number.isInteger(year)||year<1888||year>2100||!Number.isInteger(stars)||stars<0||stars>5||typeof token!=='string'||token.length>4096||/[<>\x00-\x1f]/.test(pseudo))return contributionsReply({message:'Vérifiez les champs du formulaire.'},400,origin);
  try{
   const ip=request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP')||'';
   const verify=await fetch('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body:new URLSearchParams({secret:env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY,response:token,remoteip:ip})});
   const verdict=await verify.json();if(!verdict.success)return contributionsReply({message:'Vérification antispam échouée. Réessayez.'},403,origin);
   const item={id:crypto.randomUUID(),type,kind,title:title.trim(),year,pseudo:pseudo.trim(),comment:comment.trim(),stars:type==='comment'?stars:0,created:new Date().toISOString()};
   await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.put('pending:'+item.id,JSON.stringify(item));
   return contributionsReply({message:'Merci ! Votre contribution attend la validation de Michel ou Christiane.'},200,origin);
  }catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Enregistrement indisponible. Réessayez plus tard.'},503,origin);}
 }
 if(path==='/contributions/moderation'&&['GET','POST'].includes(request.method)){
  const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
  if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return contributionsReply({message:'Accès refusé.'},401,origin);
  if(request.method==='GET'){
   try{if(!env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV)throw Error();const keys=await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.list({prefix:'pending:'});const pending=(await Promise.all(keys.keys.map(k=>env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.get(k.name,'json')))).filter(Boolean);return contributionsReply({pending},200,origin);}catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Modération indisponible.'},502,origin);}
  }
  if(origin!==url.origin)return contributionsReply({message:'Origine non autorisée'},403,origin);
  let body;try{body=await request.json();}catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Requête invalide'},400,origin);}
  if(!['approve','reject'].includes(body?.action)||typeof body?.id!=='string')return contributionsReply({message:'Action invalide'},400,origin);
  try{
   if(!env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV||!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(body.id))return contributionsReply({message:'Stockage indisponible ou identifiant invalide'},400,origin);
   const item=await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.get('pending:'+body.id,'json');
   if(!item)return contributionsReply({message:'Contribution introuvable.'},404,origin);
   if(body.action==='approve'&&item.type==='comment'){
    const published=await contributionsRead(env,CONTRIBUTIONS_PUBLIC);
    if(!published.items.some(x=>x.id===item.id))await contributionsWrite(env,CONTRIBUTIONS_PUBLIC,[...published.items,item],published.sha);
   }
   // Une suggestion acceptée reste une proposition : Michel ajoute ensuite le titre via le formulaire habituel.
   await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.delete('pending:'+body.id);
   return contributionsReply({message:item.type==='suggestion'&&body.action==='approve'?'Proposition validée. Ajoutez maintenant le titre via le formulaire vert.':'Modération enregistrée.',suggestion:item.type==='suggestion'&&body.action==='approve'?item:null},200,origin);
  }catch{return contributionsReply({message:'Écriture impossible. Réessayez.'},503,origin);}
 }
 return contributionsReply({message:'Page introuvable'},404,origin);
}

// CINEMALAND — Décors TMDB : recherche exacte et fiche par identifiant.
async function tmdbDetails(request, env, url) {
  const headers = {
    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': isSiteOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin')) ? request.headers.get('Origin') : SITE_ORIGIN,
    'Vary':'Origin',
    'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control':'public, max-age=86400',
    'X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff'
  };
  const respond=(data,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers});
  if(request.method!=='GET')return respond({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
  if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return respond({message:'Clé TMDB absente'},503);
  const type=url.searchParams.get('type')==='tv'?'tv':'movie';
  const rawId=url.searchParams.get('id')||'';
  const title=(url.searchParams.get('title')||'').trim();
  const year=url.searchParams.get('year')||'';
  if(rawId && !/^\d{1,12}$/.test(rawId))return respond({message:'Identifiant invalide'},400);
  if(!rawId && (!title || title.length>160 || (year&&!/^\d{4}$/.test(year))))
    return respond({message:'Titre ou année invalide'},400);
  const api='https://api.themoviedb.org/3';
  const key=encodeURIComponent(env.TMDB_API_KEY);
  try {
    let id=rawId;
    if(!id){
      const query=api+'/search/'+type+'?api_key='+key+'&language=fr-FR&query='+encodeURIComponent(title);
      const search=await fetch(query);
      if(!search.ok)throw Error('Recherche TMDB impossible');
      const results=(await search.json()).results||[];
      const normalize=x=>String(x||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
      const sameTitle=results.filter(x=>normalize(x.title||x.name)===normalize(title)||normalize(x.original_title||x.original_name)===normalize(title));
      const matches=sameTitle.filter(x=>!year||String(x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4)===year);
      // Si le millésime du catalogue diffère de TMDB, n'accepter qu'un titre unique.
      const selected=matches.length===1?matches:(matches.length===0&&sameTitle.length===1?sameTitle:[]);
      if(selected.length!==1)return respond({details:null,message:'Identification TMDB non certaine'});
      id=String(selected[0].id);
    }
    const r=await fetch(api+'/'+type+'/'+id+'?api_key='+key+'&language=fr-FR&append_to_response=credits,aggregate_credits,external_ids');
    if(!r.ok)return respond({details:null,message:'Fiche TMDB indisponible'},r.status===404?404:502);
    const d=await r.json();
    return respond({details:{id:d.id,runtime:type==='tv'?((d.episode_run_time||[]).map(Number).find(n=>n>0)||Number(d.last_episode_to_air?.runtime)||null):(Number(d.runtime)>0?Number(d.runtime):null),episode_run_time:type==='tv'?(d.episode_run_time||[]).map(Number).filter(n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0):[],budget:Number(d.budget)>0?Number(d.budget):null,budget_currency:'USD',imdb_id:/^tt[0-9]{7,12}$/.test(d.imdb_id||d.external_ids?.imdb_id||'')?(d.imdb_id||d.external_ids.imdb_id):null,backdrop_path:d.backdrop_path||null,poster_path:d.poster_path||null,title:d.title||d.name||'',year:String(d.release_date||d.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4),cast:(type==='tv'?(d.aggregate_credits?.cast||d.credits?.cast||[]):(d.credits?.cast||[])).slice(0,10).map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name,character:p.character||(p.roles||[]).map(r=>r.character).filter(Boolean).join(' / '),profile_path:p.profile_path||null}))}});
  }catch(e){return respond({details:null,message:'Service TMDB momentanément indisponible'},502)}
}



// Exclusions TMDB persistantes : uniquement les identifiants, jamais les homonymes par nom.
async function personExclusions(request,env,url){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 const headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(origin)?origin:'null','Vary':'Origin','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization, Content-Type','Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'};
 const send=(obj,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(obj),{status,headers});
 if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers});
 if(origin&&!isSiteOrigin(origin))return send({message:'Origine refusée'},403);
 if(!env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV)return send({message:'Stockage permanent non configuré.'},503);
 if(request.method==='GET'){
  try{const keys=await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.list({prefix:'excluded-person:'});return send({ids:keys.keys.map(k=>k.name.slice('excluded-person:'.length))})}
  catch{return send({message:'Lecture des exclusions impossible.'},502)}
 }
 if(request.method!=='POST')return send({message:'Méthode non autorisée.'},405);
 const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
 if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return send({message:'Mot de passe administrateur incorrect.'},401);
 if(!env.GITHUB_TOKEN||!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return send({message:'Service non configuré.'},503);
 let payload;try{payload=await request.json()}catch{return send({message:'Données invalides.'},400)}
 const id=String(payload.id||'');const name=String(payload.name||'').trim();const role=payload.role;
 if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id)||!['actor','director'].includes(role)||!name||name.length>120)return send({message:'Personne invalide.'},400);
 try{
  const [person,movie,tv]=await Promise.all([tmdb(env,'/person/'+id),tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/movie_credits'),tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/tv_credits')]);
  if(normPerson(person.name)!==normPerson(name))return send({message:'Identité TMDB différente : suppression refusée.'},409);
  const gh=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/catalogue.js?t='+Date.now(),{headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+env.GITHUB_TOKEN,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'Cinemaland-Exclusions'},cache:'no-store'});
  if(!gh.ok)return send({message:'Vérification du catalogue impossible.'},502);
  const file=await gh.json();const source=new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob((file.content||'').replace(/\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)));
  const match=source.match(/window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*\])\s*;\s*$/);
  if(!match)return send({message:'Catalogue illisible.'},502);
  const catalogue=JSON.parse(match[1]);
  const credits=role==='actor'?[...(movie.cast||[]),...(tv.cast||[])]:[...(movie.crew||[]).filter(x=>x.job==='Director'),...(tv.crew||[]).filter(x=>['Director','Creator'].includes(x.job))];
  const creditIds=new Set(credits.map(x=>String(x.id)+'|'+(x.title?'movie':'tv')));
  const creditNames=new Set(credits.map(x=>normPerson(x.title||x.name)+'|'+String((x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4))));
  const related=catalogue.filter(f=>{
   const members=role==='actor'?(f.cast||f.actors||[]):[...(f.directors||[]),...(f.creators||[])];
   if(!members.some(p=>normPerson(typeof p==='string'?p:p?.name)===normPerson(name)))return false;
   const kind=String(f.kind||f.type||'').toLowerCase();const type=/serie|série|tv|series/.test(kind)?'tv':'movie';
   const byId=f.tmdb_id||f.tmdbId||f.id;
   if(byId&&creditIds.has(String(byId)+'|'+type))return true;
   return creditNames.has(normPerson(f.title)+'|'+String(f.year||''));
  });
  if(related.length)return send({message:'Suppression bloquée : cette fiche TMDB est liée à des titres du catalogue.',titles:related.map(x=>x.title).slice(0,30)},409);
  await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.put('excluded-person:'+id,JSON.stringify({name,role,date:new Date().toISOString()}));
  return send({ok:true,id});
 }catch(e){return send({message:'Vérification impossible : aucune suppression effectuée.'},502)}
}

async function personDirectory(request,env,url){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 const allowedOrigins=ALLOWED_SITE_ORIGINS;
 const headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':allowedOrigins.includes(origin)?origin:SITE_ORIGIN,'Vary':'Origin','Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'};
 const send=(data,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers});
 if(request.method!=='GET')return send({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
 if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return send({message:'Clé TMDB absente'},503);
 try{
  if(url.pathname==='/person-search'){
   const first=(url.searchParams.get('first')||'').trim(),last=(url.searchParams.get('last')||'').trim();
   if(!first||!last||first.length+last.length>120)return send({message:'Prénom et nom requis'},400);
   const sought=normPerson(first+' '+last);
   const d=await tmdb(env,'/search/person',{query:first+' '+last});
   const people=(d.results||[]).filter(p=>normPerson(p.name)===sought).map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name,profile_path:p.profile_path,known_for_department:p.known_for_department}));
   if(env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV){const active=await Promise.all(people.map(p=>env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.get('excluded-person:'+p.id)));return send({people:people.filter((p,i)=>!active[i])})}
   return send({people});
  }
  const id=url.searchParams.get('id');
  if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id||''))return send({message:'Identifiant invalide'},400);
  if(env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV&&await env.CONTRIBUTIONS_KV.get('excluded-person:'+id))return send({message:'Fiche exclue de CINEMALAND.'},410);
  const p=await tmdb(env,'/person/'+id);
  return send({id:p.id,name:p.name,birthday:p.birthday,deathday:p.deathday,place_of_birth:p.place_of_birth,biography:p.biography,profile_path:p.profile_path,known_for_department:p.known_for_department});
 }catch(e){return send({message:'TMDB momentanément indisponible'},502)}
}


// Récompenses du film identifié par son identifiant IMDb ; aucune recherche par nom.
async function filmAwards(request,url){
 const headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin')) ? request.headers.get('Origin') : SITE_ORIGIN,'Vary':'Origin','Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Cache-Control':'public, max-age=86400'};
 const reply=(value,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(value),{status,headers:{...headers,...(status===200?{}:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'})}});
 if(request.method!=='GET')return reply({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
 const imdb=url.searchParams.get('imdb')||'';
 if(!/^tt\d{7,12}$/.test(imdb))return reply({message:'Identifiant IMDb invalide'},400);
 const query=`SELECT DISTINCT ?award ?awardLabel ?date WHERE {
 ?film wdt:P345 "${imdb}"; p:P166 ?statement.
 ?statement ps:P166 ?award; wikibase:rank ?rank.
 FILTER(?rank != wikibase:DeprecatedRank)
 OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:P585 ?date. }
 SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "fr,en". }
 } LIMIT 100`;
 try{
  const endpoint='https://query.wikidata.org/sparql?'+new URLSearchParams({query,format:'json'});
  const response=await fetch(endpoint,{headers:{'Accept':'application/sparql-results+json','User-Agent':'CINEMALAND/1.0 (film awards)'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(8000),cf:{cacheTtl:86400,cacheEverything:true}});
  if(!response.ok)throw Error('Source indisponible');
  const data=await response.json();
  if(!Array.isArray(data.results?.bindings))throw Error('Réponse invalide');
  const seen=new Set(),awards=[];
  for(const row of data.results.bindings){
   const label=row.awardLabel?.value||'',year=(row.date?.value||'').slice(0,4);
   if(!label||/^Q\d+$/.test(label))continue;
   const key=label+'|'+year;if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);
   awards.push({name:label,year:/^\d{4}$/.test(year)?year:null});
  }
  awards.sort((a,b)=>(a.year||'').localeCompare(b.year||'')||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'fr'));
  return reply({awards,source:'Wikidata',complete:false});
 }catch{return reply({awards:null,message:'Récompenses momentanément indisponibles'},502)}
}


// Agence de voyages : titres TMDB par pays de production, sans écriture GitHub.
async function voyagesPays(request,env,url){
 const headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin')) ? request.headers.get('Origin') : SITE_ORIGIN,'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store','Vary':'Origin'};
 const send=(obj,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(obj),{status,headers});
 if(request.method!=='GET')return send({message:'Méthode non autorisée'},405);
 const country=(url.searchParams.get('pays')||'').toUpperCase();
 const page=Math.min(500,Math.max(1,Number(url.searchParams.get('page'))||1));
 if(!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(country))return send({message:'Pays invalide'},400);
 if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return send({message:'TMDB non configuré'},503);
 try{
  const params={with_origin_country:country,sort_by:'popularity.desc',include_adult:'false',page:String(page)};
  const [movies,shows]=await Promise.all([tmdb(env,'/discover/movie',{...params,with_origin_country:country}),tmdb(env,'/discover/tv',params)]);
  const map=(items,kind)=>items.filter(x=>x.id&&(x.title||x.name)).map(x=>({id:x.id,kind,title:x.title||x.name,year:(x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4),overview:x.overview||'',poster:x.poster_path||null}));
  return send({movies:map(movies.results||[],'Film'),series:map(shows.results||[],'Série'),pages:{movies:movies.total_pages||0,series:shows.total_pages||0}});
 }catch(e){return send({message:'TMDB momentanément indisponible'},502)}
}


// Vérification manuelle des pays de production : accès administrateur uniquement.
async function productionReview(request,env,url){
 const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
 if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!env.GITHUB_TOKEN||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||
    !await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reply('Accès administrateur refusé.',401);
 if(!['GET','POST'].includes(request.method))return reply('Méthode non autorisée.',405);
 if(request.method==='POST'&&request.headers.get('Origin')!==url.origin)return reply('Origine non autorisée.',403);
 const ghHeaders={'Authorization':'Bearer '+env.GITHUB_TOKEN,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json',
  'Content-Type':'application/json','User-Agent':'CINEMALAND-Production','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};
 const fileUrl='https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/catalogue.js';
 try{
  const res=await fetch(fileUrl+'?t='+Date.now(),{headers:ghHeaders,cache:'no-store'});
  if(!res.ok)return reply('Lecture du catalogue GitHub impossible ('+res.status+').',502);
  const file=await res.json();
  const binary=atob((file.content||'').replace(/\s/g,''));
  const source=new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(binary,c=>c.charCodeAt(0)));
  const match=source.match(/(window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*)(\[[\s\S]*\])(\s*;\s*$)/);
  if(!match)return reply('Format de catalogue non reconnu : aucune modification.',422);
  const entries=JSON.parse(match[2]);
  if(url.pathname==='/production-review/suggest'){
   if(request.method!=='GET')return reply('Méthode non autorisée.',405);
   const index=Number(url.searchParams.get('index'));
   if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=entries.length)return reply('Titre introuvable.',404);
   const item=entries[index];
   if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return reply('Clé TMDB absente.',503);
   const type=item.kind==='Série'?'tv':'movie';
   const search=await tmdb(env,'/search/'+type,{query:item.title,include_adult:'false'});
   const norm=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
   const matches=(search.results||[]).filter(x=>norm(x.title||x.name)===norm(item.title));
   const exact=matches.find(x=>Number((x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4))===Number(item.year));
   if(!exact)return reply('Correspondance TMDB exacte (titre et année) introuvable : renseignez manuellement.',404);
   const detail=await tmdb(env,'/'+type+'/'+exact.id);
   const countries=(detail.production_countries||[]).map(x=>x.iso_3166_1).filter(Boolean);
   return reply('Proposition TMDB.',200,{countries:[...new Set(countries)],match:exact.title||exact.name,year:item.year});
  }
  if(request.method==='GET')return reply('Catalogue lu.',200,{total:entries.length,
   items:entries.map((x,index)=>({...x,index})).filter(x=>!Array.isArray(x.production_countries)||x.production_countries.length===0)
    .map(x=>({index:x.index,title:x.title,kind:x.kind,year:x.year,poster:x.poster}))});
  const body=await request.json();
  const index=body.index;
  if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=entries.length)return reply('Index invalide.',400);
  const item=entries[index];
  if(item.title!==body.title||item.kind!==body.kind||Number(item.year)!==Number(body.year))return reply('Catalogue modifié entre-temps : rechargez la liste.',409);
  if(Array.isArray(item.production_countries)&&item.production_countries.length)return reply('Ce titre possède déjà un pays : aucune modification.',409);
  const countries=body.countries;
  if(!Array.isArray(countries)||countries.length<1||countries.length>15||countries.some(c=>typeof c!=='string'||!(/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(c))))return reply('Codes pays invalides.',400);
  item.production_countries=[...new Set(countries)];
  const updated=source.slice(0,match.index)+match[1]+JSON.stringify(entries,null,2)+match[3]+source.slice(match.index+match[0].length);
  const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(updated);let binaryOut='';
  for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=8192)binaryOut+=String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(i,i+8192));
  const write=await fetch(fileUrl,{method:'PUT',headers:ghHeaders,body:JSON.stringify({message:'CINEMALAND : pays de production — '+item.title,sha:file.sha,content:btoa(binaryOut)})});
  if(!write.ok)return reply(write.status===409?'Conflit GitHub : rechargez la liste.':'Enregistrement GitHub impossible ('+write.status+').',502);
  return reply('Pays enregistrés.',200,{title:item.title,countries:item.production_countries});
 }catch(e){return reply('Vérification impossible : '+String(e.message||e),502)}
}


// Administration 2 : corrections manuelles, identifiants TMDB immuables.
// Téléversement d'affiches locales : uniquement pour une fiche déjà présente dans le catalogue.
async function admin2PosterUpload(request,env){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 if(origin&&!isSiteOrigin(origin))return reply('Origine refusée.',403);
 const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
 if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!env.GITHUB_TOKEN||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reply('Accès refusé.',401);
 if(request.method!=='POST')return reply('Méthode interdite.',405);
 try{
  const body=await request.json();
  const index=body.index;
  if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0)return reply('Index invalide.',400);
  const mime=String(body.mime||'');
  const ext={'image/jpeg':'jpg','image/png':'png','image/webp':'webp'}[mime];
  if(!ext)return reply('Format accepté : JPG, PNG ou WebP.',400);
  const content=String(body.content||'');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(content)||content.length>7_000_000||content.length<40)return reply('Image invalide ou trop volumineuse (maximum 5 Mo).',400);
  const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(content),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
  if(bytes.length>5*1024*1024)return reply('Image supérieure à 5 Mo.',400);
  const jpg=bytes[0]===255&&bytes[1]===216&&bytes[2]===255;
  const png=bytes[0]===137&&bytes[1]===80&&bytes[2]===78&&bytes[3]===71;
  const webp=bytes.length>12&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0,4))==='RIFF'&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8,12))==='WEBP';
  if(!(ext==='jpg'&&jpg||ext==='png'&&png||ext==='webp'&&webp))return reply('Le contenu ne correspond pas au format annoncé.',400);
  const headers=reviewHeaders(env);
  const cat=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/catalogue.js?t='+Date.now(),{headers,cache:'no-store'});
  if(!cat.ok)return reply('Lecture du catalogue : '+cat.status,502);
  const catFile=await cat.json();
  if(body.sha!==catFile.sha)return reply('Catalogue modifié : rechargez les titres avant de continuer.',409);
  const source=new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob((catFile.content||'').replace(/\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)));
  const match=source.match(/window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*\])\s*;\s*$/);
  if(!match)return reply('Format catalogue inconnu.',422);
  const entries=JSON.parse(match[1]);const item=entries[index];
  if(!item||!['Film','Série'].includes(item.kind))return reply('Fiche introuvable.',404);
  const slug=String(item.title||'affiche').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'').slice(0,75)||'affiche';
  const path='affiches/'+slug+'.'+ext;
  const gh='https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+path;
  const existing=await fetch(gh,{headers,cache:'no-store'});
  if(existing.status!==404&&!existing.ok)return reply('Vérification GitHub : '+existing.status,502);
  const payload={message:'CINEMALAND : affiche '+String(item.title||''),content};
  if(existing.ok){const old=await existing.json();payload.sha=old.sha;}
  const put=await fetch(gh,{method:'PUT',headers,body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  if(!put.ok)return reply('Envoi de l’affiche sur GitHub : '+put.status,502);
  return reply('Affiche envoyée.',200,{path});
 }catch(e){return reply('Erreur affiche : '+String(e.message||e),502)}
}

// Photos locales des acteurs et réalisateurs : même principe que les affiches.
async function admin2PhotoUpload(request,env){
 const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
 if(origin&&!isSiteOrigin(origin))return reply('Origine refusée.',403);
 const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
 if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!env.GITHUB_TOKEN||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reply('Accès refusé.',401);
 if(request.method!=='POST')return reply('Méthode interdite.',405);
 try{
  const body=await request.json();const id=String(body.id||'');
  if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id))return reply('Identifiant TMDB de personne obligatoire.',400);
  const mime=String(body.mime||'');const ext={'image/jpeg':'jpg','image/png':'png','image/webp':'webp'}[mime];
  if(!ext)return reply('Format accepté : JPG, PNG ou WebP.',400);
  const content=String(body.content||'');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(content)||content.length>7_000_000||content.length<40)return reply('Image invalide ou trop volumineuse (maximum 5 Mo).',400);
  const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(content),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
  if(bytes.length>5*1024*1024)return reply('Photo supérieure à 5 Mo.',400);
  const jpg=bytes[0]===255&&bytes[1]===216&&bytes[2]===255;
  const png=bytes[0]===137&&bytes[1]===80&&bytes[2]===78&&bytes[3]===71;
  const webp=bytes.length>12&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0,4))==='RIFF'&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8,12))==='WEBP';
  if(!(ext==='jpg'&&jpg||ext==='png'&&png||ext==='webp'&&webp))return reply('Le contenu ne correspond pas au format annoncé.',400);
  const slug=String(body.name||'personne').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'').slice(0,65)||'personne';
  const path='photos/'+slug+(id.startsWith('name:')?'':'-'+id)+'.'+ext;
  const gh='https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+path;
  const headers=reviewHeaders(env);const existing=await fetch(gh,{headers,cache:'no-store'});
  if(existing.status!==404&&!existing.ok)return reply('Vérification GitHub : '+existing.status,502);
  const payload={message:'CINEMALAND : photo '+String(body.name||id),content};
  if(existing.ok){const old=await existing.json();payload.sha=old.sha;}
  const put=await fetch(gh,{method:'PUT',headers,body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  if(!put.ok)return reply('Envoi de la photo sur GitHub : '+put.status,502);
  return reply('Photo envoyée.',200,{path});
 }catch(e){return reply('Erreur photo : '+String(e.message||e),502)}
}

async function admin2Route(request,env,url){
 const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
 if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||!env.GITHUB_TOKEN||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||auth.length>1024||!await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reply('Accès refusé.',401);
 if(!['GET','POST'].includes(request.method))return reply('Méthode interdite.',405);
 if(request.method==='POST'&&!isSiteOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin')||''))return reply('Origine refusée.',403);
 const name=url.searchParams.get('group')==='people'?'corrections-personnes.json':'catalogue.js';
 const gh='https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+name;
 const headers=reviewHeaders(env);
 try{
  const r=await fetch(gh+'?t='+Date.now(),{headers,cache:'no-store'});
  if(!r.ok&&!(name.endsWith('.json')&&r.status===404))return reply('Lecture GitHub : '+r.status,502);
  const file=r.ok?await r.json():{sha:null,content:''};
  const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob((file.content||'').replace(/\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
  const source=new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
  const match=name==='catalogue.js'?source.match(/(window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*)(\[[\s\S]*\])(\s*;\s*$)/):null;
  if(name==='catalogue.js'&&!match)return reply('Format catalogue inconnu.',422);
  const entries=name==='catalogue.js'?JSON.parse(match[2]):(source?JSON.parse(source):{});
  if(request.method==='GET'){
   // Compteurs calculés sur la même base que la recherche, sans modifier l'écriture.
   const counts=name==='catalogue.js'?{
    films:entries.filter(x=>x.kind==='Film').length,
    series:entries.filter(x=>x.kind==='Série').length,
    total:entries.length
   }:null;
   return reply('Données chargées.',200,{entries,sha:file.sha,...(counts?{counts}:{})});
  }
  const body=await request.json();
  if(body.sha!==file.sha)return reply('Fichier modifié entre-temps : rechargez.',409);
  let out;
  if(name==='catalogue.js'){
   const index=body.index;
   if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=entries.length)return reply('Index invalide.',400);
   const old=entries[index],next=body.data;
   if(!next||typeof next!=='object'||Array.isArray(next))return reply('Fiche invalide.',400);
   for(const k of ['tmdb_id','tmdbId','tmdb','id','tmdb_movie_id','tmdb_tv_id'])if(JSON.stringify(old[k]??null)!==JSON.stringify(next[k]??null))return reply('Identifiant verrouillé : '+k,400);
   entries[index]=next;
   out=source.slice(0,match.index)+match[1]+JSON.stringify(entries,null,2)+match[3]+source.slice(match.index+match[0].length);
  }else{
   const id=String(body.id||'');
   if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id))return reply('Identifiant TMDB de personne obligatoire.',400);
   if(!body.data||typeof body.data!=='object'||Array.isArray(body.data))return reply('Données invalides.',400);
   if(Object.keys(body.data).some(k=>['id','tmdb_id','tmdbId'].includes(k)))return reply('Identifiant verrouillé.',400);
   // Refuser toute création de personne étrangère au catalogue CINEMALAND.
   const catUrl='https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/contents/catalogue.js';
   const catResp=await fetch(catUrl,{headers,cache:'no-store'});
   if(!catResp.ok)return reply('Lecture catalogue : '+catResp.status,502);
   const catFile=await catResp.json();
   const catBytes=Uint8Array.from(atob((catFile.content||'').replace(/\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
   const catSource=new TextDecoder().decode(catBytes);
   const catMatch=catSource.match(/window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*\])\s*;\s*$/);
   if(!catMatch)return reply('Catalogue illisible.',422);
   const catalogue=JSON.parse(catMatch[1]);
   const normalizedName=value=>String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();
   const containsId=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.some(containsId):!!(value&&typeof value==='object'&&String(value.tmdb_id??value.tmdbId??value.id??'')===id);
   // Une personne sélectionnée explicitement par son ID TMDB peut avoir des crédits sans ID.
   // Vérifier le nom réel sur TMDB, et sa présence exacte dans le catalogue.
   const creditedById=catalogue.some(item=>containsId(item.cast)||containsId(item.actors)||containsId(item.director)||containsId(item.directors)||containsId(item.creators));
   if(!creditedById){
    if(!env.TMDB_API_KEY)return reply('Vérification TMDB indisponible.',503);
    let tmdbPerson;
    try{tmdbPerson=await tmdb(env,'/person/'+id)}catch{return reply('Identité TMDB impossible à vérifier.',502)}
    if(!tmdbPerson||String(tmdbPerson.id)!==id||!tmdbPerson.name)return reply('Identité TMDB non confirmée.',403);
    const exactName=normalizedName(tmdbPerson.name);
    const hasName=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.some(hasName):typeof value==='string'?normalizedName(value)===exactName:!!(value&&typeof value==='object'&&normalizedName(value.name)===exactName);
    if(!catalogue.some(item=>hasName(item.cast)||hasName(item.actors)||hasName(item.director)||hasName(item.directors)||hasName(item.creators)))return reply('Personne absente du catalogue : création interdite.',403);
   }
   entries[id]=body.data;out=JSON.stringify(entries,null,2)+'\n';
  }
  const encoded=new TextEncoder().encode(out);let binary='';for(let i=0;i<encoded.length;i+=8192)binary+=String.fromCharCode(...encoded.slice(i,i+8192));
  const payload={message:'CINEMALAND : correction manuelle administration 2',content:btoa(binary)};if(file.sha)payload.sha=file.sha;
  const put=await fetch(gh,{method:'PUT',headers,body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  if(!put.ok)return reply('Écriture GitHub : '+put.status,put.status===409?409:502);
  return reply('Correction enregistrée.',200);
 }catch(e){return reply('Erreur : '+String(e.message||e),502)}
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    if (
      request.method === 'GET' &&
      (url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/admin.html')
    ) {
      return new Response(ADMIN_HTML, {
        headers:{
          ...security,
          'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8'
        }
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/admin2-poster') {
      const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
      const cors={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(origin)?origin:'null','Vary':'Origin','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization, Content-Type'};
      if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:cors});
      const response=await admin2PosterUpload(request,env);
      const headers=new Headers(response.headers);
      for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cors))headers.set(k,v);
      return new Response(response.body,{status:response.status,headers});
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/admin2-photo') {
      const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
      const cors={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(origin)?origin:'null','Vary':'Origin','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization, Content-Type'};
      if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:cors});
      const response=await admin2PhotoUpload(request,env);
      const headers=new Headers(response.headers);
      for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cors))headers.set(k,v);
      return new Response(response.body,{status:response.status,headers});
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/admin2-data') {
      const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
      const allowed=isSiteOrigin(origin);
      const cors={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':allowed?origin:'null','Vary':'Origin','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, POST, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization, Content-Type'};
      if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:cors});
      if(origin&&!allowed)return reply('Origine refusée.',403);
      const response=await admin2Route(request,env,url);
      const headers=new Headers(response.headers);
      for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cors))headers.set(k,v);
      return new Response(response.body,{status:response.status,headers});
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/production-review' || url.pathname === '/production-review/suggest') return productionReview(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname === '/admin-tmdb') {
      const origin=request.headers.get('Origin')||'';
      const cors={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':isSiteOrigin(origin)?origin:'null','Vary':'Origin','Access-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, OPTIONS','Access-Control-Allow-Headers':'Authorization, Content-Type','Access-Control-Max-Age':'600'};
      if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:cors});
      const response=await (async()=>{
      if(request.method!=='GET')return reply('Méthode non autorisée.',405);
      const auth=request.headers.get('Authorization')||'';
      if(!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD||auth.length>1024||!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')||
         !await equalSecret(auth.slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))return reply('Mot de passe administrateur incorrect.',401);
      const type=url.searchParams.get('type')||'';
      try{
        if(type==='person'){
          const id=url.searchParams.get('id')||'';
          if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(id))return reply('Identifiant TMDB invalide.',400);
          const role=url.searchParams.get('role')==='director'?'director':'actor';
          const [p,m,t]=await Promise.all([tmdb(env,'/person/'+id),tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/movie_credits'),tmdb(env,'/person/'+id+'/tv_credits')]);
          const movies=role==='director'?(m.crew||[]).filter(x=>x.job==='Director'):(m.cast||[]);
          const shows=role==='director'?(t.crew||[]).filter(x=>['Director','Creator'].includes(x.job)):(t.cast||[]);
          const allowed=x=>!x.adult&&!['Documentary','News','Talk','Reality'].includes(x.media_type)&&
            !(x.genre_ids||[]).some(g=>[99,10763,10764,10767].includes(g))&&
            !/^(self|himself|herself|archive footage|uncredited self)$/i.test(String(x.character||'').trim());
          const credits=[...movies.filter(allowed).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.title,year:(x.release_date||'').slice(0,4),kind:'movie'})),
           ...shows.filter(allowed).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.name,year:(x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4),kind:'tv'}))];
          const unique=[...new Map(credits.map(x=>[x.kind+':'+x.id,x])).values()]
            .sort((a,b)=>(b.year||'').localeCompare(a.year||''));
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({name:p.name,birthday:p.birthday,deathday:p.deathday,place_of_birth:p.place_of_birth,biography:p.biography,credits:unique}),{headers:{...security,'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
        }
