        if(!['movie','tv','actor','director'].includes(type))return reply('Type de recherche invalide.',400);
        const q=(url.searchParams.get('q')||'').trim();
        if(q.length<2||q.length>120)return reply('Recherche invalide.',400);
        const personType=type==='actor'||type==='director';
        const data=await tmdb(env,personType?'/search/person':'/search/'+type,{query:q,include_adult:'false'});
        let items=(data.results||[]);
        if(personType){
          const dept=type==='director'?'Directing':'Acting';
          items=items.filter(x=>x.known_for_department===dept||
            (x.known_for||[]).some(y=>y.media_type==='movie'||y.media_type==='tv'));
        }
        const results=items.slice(0,20).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:personType?x.name:(x.title||x.name),
          year:personType?'':(x.release_date||x.first_air_date||'').slice(0,4),
          department:personType?x.known_for_department:'',image:personType?x.profile_path:x.poster_path}));
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({type,results}),{headers:{...security,'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
      }catch(e){return reply('Recherche TMDB momentanément indisponible.',502)}
      })();
      const headers=new Headers(response.headers);
      for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cors))headers.set(k,v);
      return new Response(response.body,{status:response.status,headers});
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/voyages-pays') return voyagesPays(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/contributions/')) return contributionsRoute(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname === '/trailer') return trailerRoute(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname === '/details') return tmdbDetails(request,env,url);
    if (url.pathname === '/awards') return filmAwards(request,url);

    if (url.pathname === '/person-exclusions') return personExclusions(request,env,url);
    if (url.pathname === '/person-search' || url.pathname === '/person-detail') return personDirectory(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname === '/filmography') {
      return filmography(request, env, url);
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/status') {
      if (request.method !== 'GET') return reply('Méthode non autorisée.',405);
      if (!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || !env.GITHUB_TOKEN ||
          !(request.headers.get('Authorization') || '').startsWith('Bearer ') ||
          !await equalSecret((request.headers.get('Authorization') || '').slice(7),env.ADMIN_PASSWORD))
        return reply('Accès refusé.',401);
      const number = Number(url.searchParams.get('issue'));
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number) || number < 1) return reply('Numéro invalide.',400);
      const ghHeaders = {'Authorization':'Bearer '+env.GITHUB_TOKEN,
        'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'CINEMALAND-Admin'};
      try {
        const issueResponse = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/issues/'+number,
          {headers:ghHeaders,cache:'no-store'});
        if (!issueResponse.ok) return reply('Vérification GitHub indisponible.',502);
        const issue = await issueResponse.json();
        if (!issue.title?.startsWith('[VIDEOTHEQUE] ') || issue.user?.login !== OWNER)
          return reply('Demande non reconnue.',403);
        if (issue.state !== 'closed') return reply('En cours.',200,{state:'pending'});
        if (issue.state_reason === 'not_planned') return reply('Demande rejetée.',200,{state:'error'});
        const block = (issue.body || '').match(/```json\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```/i);
        if (!block) return reply('Données de demande manquantes.',200,{state:'error'});
        const requested = JSON.parse(block[1]);
        const page = await fetch('https://michelmalandain.github.io/Videotheque/catalogue.js?check='+Date.now(),
          {cache:'no-store'});
        if (!page.ok) return reply('Publication en cours.',200,{state:'publishing'});
        const source = await page.text();
        const match = source.match(/window\.CINEMALAND_CATALOGUE\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])\s*;/);
        if (!match) return reply('Publication en cours.',200,{state:'publishing'});
        const entries = JSON.parse(match[1]);
        const normalize = s => String(s || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();
        const present = entries.some(x => normalize(x.title) === normalize(requested.title) &&
          normalize(x.kind) === normalize(requested.kind) && Number(x.year) === Number(requested.year));
        const expected = requested.action === 'add';
        return reply(present === expected ? 'Publié.' : 'Publication en cours.',200,
          {state:present === expected ? 'success':'publishing'});
      } catch {
        return reply('Vérification temporairement indisponible.',502);
      }
    }

    if (url.pathname === '/reviews') return reviewsRoute(request,env,url);

    if (url.pathname !== '/requests') {
      return reply('Page introuvable.', 404);
    }

    if (request.method !== 'POST') {
      return reply('Méthode non autorisée.', 405);
    }

    if (request.headers.get('Origin') !== url.origin) {
      return reply('Origine non autorisée.', 403);
    }

    if (
      !env.GITHUB_TOKEN ||
      !env.ADMIN_PASSWORD ||
      env.ADMIN_PASSWORD.length < 20
    ) {
      return reply(
        'Le service doit encore être configuré par Michel.',
        503
      );
    }

    const authorization =
      request.headers.get('Authorization') || '';

    if (
      authorization.length > 1024 ||
      !authorization.startsWith('Bearer ') ||
      !await equalSecret(
        authorization.slice(7),
        env.ADMIN_PASSWORD
      )
    ) {
      return reply('Mot de passe incorrect.', 401);
    }

    if (
      !(request.headers.get('Content-Type') || '')
        .startsWith('application/json')
    ) {
      return reply('Format de demande invalide.', 415);
    }

    let raw = '';
    const reader = request.body?.getReader();

    if (!reader) {
      return reply('Demande vide.', 400);
    }

    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let bytes = 0;

    try {
      while (true) {
        const {done, value} = await reader.read();

        if (done) break;

        bytes += value.byteLength;

        if (bytes > 4096) {
          await reader.cancel();
          return reply('Demande trop longue.', 413);
        }

        raw += decoder.decode(value, {stream:true});
      }

      raw += decoder.decode();

    } catch {
      return reply('Demande illisible.', 400);
    }

    let data;

    try {
      data = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return reply('Demande invalide.', 400);
    }

    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
      return reply('Demande invalide.', 400);
    }

    const {action, title, kind, year} = data;

    if (
      !['add','delete'].includes(action) ||
      typeof title !== 'string' ||
      !title.trim() ||
      title.trim().length > 160 ||
      /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(title) ||
      !['Film','Série'].includes(kind) ||
      !Number.isInteger(year) ||
      year < 1888 ||
      year > 2100
    ) {
      return reply(
        'Vérifiez le titre, la catégorie et l’année.',
        400
      );
    }

    const payload = {
      action,
      title:title.trim(),
      kind,
      year
    };

    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(
      () => controller.abort(),
      15000
    );

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        'https://api.github.com/repos/' +
        REPOSITORY + '/issues',
        {
          method:'POST',
          headers:{
            'Authorization':'Bearer ' + env.GITHUB_TOKEN,
            'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json',
            'Content-Type':'application/json',
            'User-Agent':'Videotheque-Michel-Christiane'
          },
          body:JSON.stringify({
            title:'[VIDEOTHEQUE] ' +
              (action === 'delete' ? 'Supprimer' : 'Ajouter') +
              ' : ' + payload.title,
            body:
              'Demande créée depuis l’administration de la vidéothèque.\n\n' +
              '```json\n' +
              JSON.stringify(payload,null,2) +
              '\n```'
          }),
          signal:controller.signal
        }
      );

      if (response.status !== 201) {
        return reply(
          'Le service n’a pas pu transmettre la demande. Michel doit vérifier sa configuration.',
          502
        );
      }

      const issue = await response.json();

      if (issue.user?.login !== OWNER) {
        return reply(
          'La clé doit appartenir au compte de Michel. La demande ne sera pas traitée.',
          502
        );
      }

      return reply(
        'Demande transmise au traitement automatique.',
        202, {issue_number:issue.number}
      );

    } catch {
      return reply(
        'Transmission non confirmée. Vérifiez le catalogue dans quelques minutes avant de réessayer.',
        504
      );

    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }
};
